'some 12 investments have already been made out of it (Nex Health and Spiketrap are the only two that are public so far)' (TechCrunch, 2020-07-17, on Fund I): 20VC's own fund.

note: Social audio app (Clubhouse, Alpha Exploration Co., San Francisco). A Fund I position (Fortune, 2021-06-16). Every Clubhouse round from April 2020 (the $12M Series A a16z led in May 2020, the Series B of January 2021, the Series C of April 2021) could have been Fund I's and no source names it: undetermined. Mark: a Series C that 'brings Clubhouse's valuation to $4 billion' (Voicebot.ai, 2021-04-19, after Reuters), as in the a16z row; older than 24 months (stale). Not Greylock's Clubhouse (the project tracker renamed Shortcut; ruled distinct) and not the Wikidata GB (disputed).

In-app subscription infrastructure (San Francisco). A Fund I position (Fortune, 2021-06-16); the $15M Series A of August 2020: 'Adjacent, SaaStr, Oakhouse Partners, Josh Buckley, Harry Stebbings, Nicolas Dessaigne and Tobi Balling also participated in the investment' (Crunchbase News, 2020-08-11), inside Fund I's life (decisions.md R1). Below $1B: the Series C priced it at $500M post-money (May 2025, as in the Bain Capital Ventures row).

Contextual AI for audience and ad analytics (San Francisco). One of the twelve investments made out of Fund I by July 2020 (TechCrunch, 2020-07-17). 'Spiketrap raised $3.5 million in a seed round in 2020 ... led by Susa, 645, Pathbreaker and Anorak' (TechCrunch, 2022-09-01), its only round, so the entry is that seed (model, low: no source names 20VC in it). 'Reddit acquires Spiketrap' (TechCrunch, 2022-09-01): acquired.

Cause-based commerce platform for online retailers (ShoppingGives, Chicago). 'The Chicago-based startup raised $5.5 million in seed funding led by Caffeinated Capital and a group of investors that includes ... 20VC' (Crunchbase News, 2020-09-18). 'CPGIO ... has announced its acquisition of ShoppingGives' (PR Newswire, 2025-01-21): acquired.

Card-issuing and payments infrastructure for Latin American fintechs (Buenos Aires). 'Pomelo ... has raised $9 million in a seed round of funding'; 'Index Ventures and Brazil's monashees co-led the funding round, which also included participation from ... 20VC' (TechCrunch, 2021-05-12). $55M Series C co-led by Kaszek and Insight Partners (January 2026, the Insight row).

Quick-commerce and mass-transit startup (Lahore). The $85M Series B of August 2021 'was co-led by Harry Stebbings' 20 VC Explorer and Josh Buckley's Buckley Ventures' (MENAbytes, 2021-08-18; TechCrunch, 2021-08-17): Growth. Shut down in July 2022, as in the First Round row.

Professional social network (Polywork, New York; founder Peter Johnston). The $13M Series A led by Andreessen Horowitz: 'Bungalow Capital and 20VC were among the other participants' (Silicon Republic, 2021-08-06; Business Insider lists Harry Stebbings among its angels). 'Stripe-backed Irish LinkedIn-challenger Polywork to close' (Business Post, 2024-12-31): defunct, as in the a16z row.

Automated accounting and finance for small businesses (San Francisco). The $65M Series C at a $565M valuation: 'SoftBank's Vision Fund is leading the funding, with U.K. investor Harry Stebbings' 20VC Growth, GV and Benchmark also participating' (TechCrunch, 2022-03-24): Growth.

Low-cost international money transfer (London; founded by Robinhood alumni). The $4.5M seed: 'The round led by Amplo and Ribbit Capital alongside participation from Kleiner Perkins, Index Ventures ..., Harry Stebbings' 20VC, Elefund' (Tech Funding News, 2022-03-09). 'Deel has acquired international funds transfer company Atlantic Money' (Finovate, 2024-12-02): acquired, as in the Ribbit row.

Product-feedback hub for product teams (Cycle, from the eFounders studio). 'The company raised a total of $6 million across two funding rounds, including a recent funding round led by Boldstart that closed late last year ... Base Case, The 20VC Fund, SV Angel, BoxGroup, Hummingbird Ventures and 60 angels also invested' (TechCrunch, 2023-02-28): the article does not say which of the two rounds 20VC joined: undetermined. City from the studio's base (model).

funding_rounds.round: two rounds totalling $6M, the later led by Boldstart

note: AI note-taking hub for work (Noded AI). 'Today's $4 million investment was led by Boldstart Ventures with participation from Bessemer Venture Partners, 20VC and First Hand Ventures' (TechCrunch, 2024-07-23); the article names no round: undetermined.

AI sales agents ('digital workers'; 11x, founded in London, now San Francisco). The $24M Series A led by Benchmark: 'Other investors in the round included 20VC, Project A, Lux Capital, and SV Angel' (TechCrunch, 2024-09-16; Estadao's copy of the release adds 20Growth and 20Sales). Medium: whether 20VC was also in the 2023 seed is not stated. $50M Series B led by a16z (TechCrunch, 2024-09-30).

Cloud practice software for dental offices (Archy). '$15M Series A funding in a round led by Entree Capital with participation from Bessemer Venture Partners, CRV, Alven, 20VC Growth fund' (HIT Consultant, 2024-10-23; Pulse 2.0): the Explorer growth fund (decisions.md D1). No source read gives the HQ; US is a model read at low confidence.

Luggage-storage network for travellers (San Francisco). 'Bounce's Series B was led by Sapphire Sport, with participation from existing investors including Andreessen Horowitz and General Catalyst, as well as new investors 20VC Growth, FJ Labs' (TechCrunch, 2024-11-12; $19M): Growth. Same company as the a16z and General Catalyst rows; not Accel's Bounce (the Bangalore scooter company; ruled distinct).

AI performance science for elite athletes (Orreco, Galway). At the $4M round of December 2025: 'Existing investors include True Ventures, Jason Calacanis, 20VC and professional golfer Padraig Harrington' (Silicon Republic, 2025-12-15). No source says when or in which round 20VC entered: undetermined.

Financial-audit automation (Denki, YC F25; 'San Francisco-based Denki', founded by two brothers who studied in London). 'Base10 Partners and Shine Capital co-led the raise, which included participation from Y Combinator, 20VC and others' (Crunchbase News, 2026-03-05, $4.1M); FinSMEs' headline calls it seed funding, but the page did not load, so the stage is model-sourced.

AI agents for finance teams (Zalos, London and San Francisco; YC F25). '$3.6m in a seed funding round ... led by Swiss VC 14Peaks Capital'; 'Other investors include Cohen Circle, Harry Stebbings' 20VC and several angels' (Tech.eu, 2026-03-24).

Operating system for human and AI-agent teams (Lua; 'Irish co-founded and London-based', Silicon Republic). 'Norrsken22 led the seed round. Flourish Ventures, 20VC, P1 Ventures, Phosphor Capital and Y Combinator also participated' (SiliconANGLE, 2026-04-16; $5.8M).

AI performance-marketing platform replacing agencies (Uplane, San Francisco; YC F25). 'The seed round was led by Play Ventures, with participation from Y Combinator, 20VC, Rebel Fund and Multimodal Ventures' (The American Bazaar, 2026-09-04; first reported by jawlah, 2026-04-19, $4.5M).

Agentic supply-chain operations for consumer brands (Corvera, founded in London, 'based in San Francisco'; YC W26). 'GBP 3 million ($4.2 million) in seed funding ... led by 6 Degrees Capital, with participation from ... 20VC, Rebel Fund' (Retail Technology Innovation Hub, 2026-05-05).

AI-native law firm (Moritz, formerly Arcline; YC W26). 'San Francisco-based startup Moritz ... raised $9 million in a seed round through its MSO Parlai, led by startup incubator Y Combinator and venture capital fund 20VC' (Law.com, 2026-05-05; Tech Funding News the same day).

User verification and anti-fraud onboarding replacing CAPTCHAs and SMS codes (Prelude, Paris; founded by ex-Zenly engineers). 'French digital onboarding startup Prelude has raised $20m in a Series A funding round led by Harry Stebbings' 20VC, which is investing in the startup for the first time' (Tech.eu, 2026-05-20). Not Insight's Prelude (Seattle security control monitoring; ruled distinct) and not the Wikidata US (disputed).

Cross-company AI agents for enterprise software integration (ArchAstro, Seattle area; ex-Microsoft, Stripe and Meta engineers). 'pre-seed funding of $6.2 million from a marquee list of investors'; 'ArchAstro is backed by venture capital firms 20VC ... and Kyber Knight' (GeekWire, 2026-06-09). Medium: the article lists 20VC as a backer beside the pre-seed rather than inside a named round line.

Secure data access for enterprise AI agents (Archestra.AI, London; founded 2025 by Grafana Labs alumni). '$10m in a seed funding round, led by Harry Stebbings' 20VC, a new investor in the startup' (Tech.eu, 2026-06-02; $13.5M raised to date).

AI phone agents for small businesses (fonio.ai, Vienna). 'fonio.ai has closed a $17 million seed round at a $140 million valuation, led by 20VC' (Tech Funding News, 2026-06-09), six months after a EUR 3M angel round.

AI-native generalist robots for industrial production (THEKER, Barcelona). 'THEKER raises $85M in Europe's largest ever robotics Series A, led by CRV'; 'with participation from Samsung, LVMH, Cathay, 20VC, Henkel, Korelya, Sonae and Mercadona alongside existing investors Inditex' (Cathay Capital's post, 2026-06-11); 20VC is not among the existing investors named.

User-generated prediction markets (XO Market; co-founders Ali Habbabeh and Walid Al Habboul). 'The startup, which just closed a $6 million seed round led by 20VC, Picus Capital, Coinbase Ventures, Venture Together and a group of angels' (CoinDesk, 2026-04-30); a $500K pre-seed of July 2025 names no 20VC. No source read gives an HQ (reports place the team in San Francisco, the CEO in Switzerland): US at low confidence.

Messaging and document exchange between shippers, forwarders and truck drivers (ZeKju, Augsburg). 'Augsburg-based ZeKju GmbH has raised capital from investors including 20VC, Prequel Ventures, Combination Ventures and SDAC as part of its seed financing round' (Taylor Wessing, 2024-09-13); the company's own announcement called the round 'led by 20VC'.

CRM (Zero, zero.inc, Helsinki). At the $10.3M seed led by Primary Venture Partners the founders thank 'the people who backed us at pre-seed, when there genuinely was nothing to look at: Kieran Hill, Harry Stebbings' (ArcticToday, 2026-09-15): 20VC's partners by name, dating the entry of a company the firm lists since 2024-09 (decisions.md R1). Helsinki, not the Wikidata JP (disputed).

Inference framework running models across AI chips (ZML, Paris; founder Steeve Morin, ex-Zenly). 'Morin raised $20 million from venture firms including Harry Stebbings' 20VC, >commit, AALVC, Drysdale Ventures, Xavier Niel's Kima Ventures, Kindred Capital, LocalGlobe, and Puzzle Ventures' (TechCrunch, 2026-07-08): a total, not a round; the firm listed ZML by 2024-09, and no source names the round 20VC joined: undetermined.

Patient-experience platform and healthcare API (NexHealth, San Francisco). One of the twelve investments made out of Fund I by July 2020: 'Nex Health and Spiketrap are the only two that are public so far' (TechCrunch, 2020-07-17), so the position is Fund I's, entered between April and July 2020; TechCrunch (2020-06-30) lists Harry Stebbings among the backers on $12 million raised by then. Neither article names the round (the 2020 round follows the September 2019 seed Point Nine led): undetermined. Mark: 'NexHealth Raises $125M Series C at $1B Valuation' (the company, 2022-04-21), as in the Point Nine row; older than 24 months (stale).
